_note: Apple-only listing inputs for scripts/store-config.mjs. `advisory` = App Store age-rating questionnaire answers that differ from the all-NONE/false default (keys as App Store Connect names them; values NONE | INFREQUENT_OR_MILD | FREQUENT_OR_INTENSE or booleans). `review` = App Review contact (NOT public — the private number is allowed here per the PHONE RULE; the public SIM is for DSA/listing surfaces). `release` = what happens after approval.
